create_preconditions: job_id and input raw_capture_sha256 are present

record_fields.instruction_version: version of the separate control instruction
record_fields.provider_name: provider adapter identifier, for example mock
record_fields.model_name: provider model identifier or local fixture identifier
record_fields.input_raw_capture_sha256: provenance link to the exact analyzed source input
record_fields.input_json: exact provider-independent JD input used for this analysis

persistence_policy.pending_output: may be stored as a separate needs_review analysis record after contract validation
persistence_policy.approved_output: remains a separate approved analysis record; does not overwrite source job facts
persistence_policy.rejected_output: remains stored with review note for failure learning; does not affect job facts
